admission.justification: A host read blocked by the runtime must leave the launch lock available, while a stale observation cannot overwrite a replacement receipt.

applicability: Role launcher Options requests and the receipt observations they apply.
conditions: The early Options check returns before catalogue or receipt host access while the dispatch lock is already held.
Non-taskless receipt liveness is read outside the lock. The locked comparison applies the observation only to the same receipt contents.
exclusions: Taskless option listings read saved execution data. Taskless Result uses an exact saved request and validates its address.

evidence: F01 parked Architect options/result and concurrent migration tests, busy zero-host and stale receipt checks on W3.

statement: A launch in progress prevents new options host calls, and receipt reads apply observations only after revalidating the unchanged receipt.
